notes: Site says: "Voyager Infinity integrates the multi-job posting solution LogicMelon."

connections.quote: Jobs from the Infinity database are automatically sent to Broadbean for dispatch to the largest network of job boards in the world.
Jobs from the Infinity database are automatically sent to LogicMelon for dispatch to your selection of their extensive job board network.

sources.quote: Voyager Infinity is recruitment software built specifically for UK recruitment agencies, supporting permanent, contract and temporary recruitment from a single cloud-based platform.
